table_audit_findings.specified_value: As BS 5911 Part 3 to the sizes given on the standard Drawings
table_audit_findings.proposed_value: As BS 5911 Part 3 to the sizes given on the standard Drawings

table_audit_findings.specified_value: Covers and frames for access to pumping station sumps and valve chambers shall comply with BS EN 124.
table_audit_findings.proposed_value: Covers and frames for access to pumping station sumps and valve chambers shall comply with BS EN 124.

table_audit_findings.specified_value: AGR sealing plate and heavy grease seal, to be formed between the cover and frame, shall be provided to prevent the ingress of sand.
table_audit_findings.proposed_value: AGR sealing plate and heavy grease seal, to be formed between the cover and frame, shall be provided to prevent the ingress of sand.

table_audit_findings.specified_value: Covers and frames shall be unvented and made of spheroidal graphite cast iron (ductile iron as per ISO 1083:2018 Or GRP composite that meet or exceed the requirements of BS EN 124-1 & BS EN 124-5.
table_audit_findings.proposed_value: Covers and frames shall be unvented and made of spheroidal graphite cast iron (ductile iron as per ISO 1083 Grade 500/7 that meet or exceed the requirements of BS EN 124-1 & BS EN 124-5.

table_audit_findings.specified_value: Covers (for manholes, kerb inlet, flush inlets), shall comply with all relevant and applicable requirements of the Abu Dhabi standards published by Abu Dhabi QCC.
table_audit_findings.proposed_value: Covers (for manholes, kerb inlet, flush inlets), shall comply with all relevant and applicable requirements of the Abu Dhabi standards published by Abu Dhabi QCC.

table_audit_findings.specified_value: As per Figure 5 in BS EN 124-1-2015. Class D400 in bus stops, taxi stops, lay byes and any parking alongside carriageways; C250 in pedestrian areas; Class B125 in locations not subject to vehicular traffic.
table_audit_findings.proposed_value: As per Figure 5 in BS EN 124-1-2015. Class D400 in bus stops, taxi stops, lay byes and any parking alongside carriageways; C250 in pedestrian areas; Class B125 in locations not subject to vehicular traffic.

table_audit_findings.parameter: Covers to storm water drain manholes, kerb inlet covers, flush inlet covers
table_audit_findings.specified_value: Shall be classified as non-rocking and single piece. GRP composite covers made in multiple sections may be accepted on the condition of compliance with BS EN 124-5.
table_audit_findings.proposed_value: Shall be classified as non-rocking and single piece. GRP composite covers made in multiple sections may be accepted on the condition of compliance with BS EN 124-5.

table_audit_findings.specified_value: Provide in Arabic and English: a) STORMWATER YEAR OF PROJECT STANDARD b) Purpose of application (STORMWATER..etc) for 150x150m surface boxes
table_audit_findings.proposed_value: Provide in Arabic and English: a) STORMWATER YEAR OF PROJECT STANDARD b) Purpose of application (STORMWATER..etc) for 150x150m surface boxes

table_audit_findings.specified_value: Multiple ducts covers and frames shall be cast iron, water proof and non-rocking. They shall be of the type incorporating integral removable intermediate beams to give the required clear pit opening shown in the Drawings. All covers frames and supporting metal work shall be designed for loading to BS EN 1990.
table_audit_findings.proposed_value: Multiple ducts covers and frames shall be cast iron, water proof and non-rocking. They shall be of the type incorporating integral removable intermediate beams to give the required clear pit opening shown in the Drawings. All covers frames and supporting metal work shall be designed for loading to BS EN 1990.

table_audit_findings.parameter: Covers and frames and multiple ducts covers and frames
table_audit_findings.specified_value: Covers and frames and multiple ducts covers and frames shall be coated in accordance with Section 09900 , table 9.01, exposure class C2 . Coated covers and frames shall not be handled and transported until full cure has been achieved. An original of the approved coating specialist quality control report for each itemized component shall be provided with each delivery. The report shall bear an original company stamp and signature.
table_audit_findings.proposed_value: Covers and frames and multiple ducts covers and frames shall be coated in accordance with Section 09900 , table 9.01, exposure class C2 . Coated covers and frames shall not be handled and transported until full cure has been achieved. An original of the approved coating specialist quality control report for each itemized component shall be provided with each delivery. The report shall bear an original company stamp and signature.

table_audit_findings.specified_value: Covers and frames to be provided with proper key holes for easy lifting , heavy covers to be Provided with special lifting hooks.
table_audit_findings.proposed_value: Covers and frames to be provided with proper key holes for easy lifting , heavy covers to be Provided with special lifting hooks.

table_audit_findings.specified_value: Surface boxes shall include a cast iron heavy duty covers and frame and be suitable for wheel loads of 11.43 tons . Ductile iron surface boxes may be used if requested by Engineer .They shall be coated in accordance with section 09900, table 09900-01 exposure class C2. Surface boxes shall have a 150mm diameter clear opening and the cover shall be attached to the frame by a hinge.
table_audit_findings.proposed_value: Surface boxes shall include a cast iron heavy duty covers and frame and be suitable for wheel loads of 11.43 tons . Ductile iron surface boxes may be used if requested by Engineer .They shall be coated in accordance with section 09900, table 09900-01 exposure class C2. Surface boxes shall have a 150mm diameter clear opening and the cover shall be attached to the frame by a hinge.

table_audit_findings.specified_value: Cover badging shall include: Cast Iron/ductile iron, size ( clear opening ) , foundry logs and name , foundry batching number to covers and frames and class.
table_audit_findings.proposed_value: Cover badging will include: ductile iron, size ( clear opening ) , foundry name , foundry batching number to covers and frames and class.
